name: gitops-monorepo
description: GitOps monorepo: application, Helm chart, cluster config and pipeline in one repository.
//: npm workspace root. ONE lockfile lives here and covers app/. The Docker build context is therefore the repo ROOT (not ./app) so the image build can see it — see app/Dockerfile and the build-push stage.
//overrides: express@4.x pins path-to-regexp to the 0.1.x line, which carries two HIGH ReDoS CVEs: CVE-2024-52798 (fixed in 0.1.12) and CVE-2026-4867 (fixed in 0.1.13). The Trivy gate in build-push caught them and correctly refused to push the image. npm only honours `overrides` in the WORKSPACE ROOT, so the pin lives here rather than in app/package.json. Both CI and the Docker build read this file, so the fix reaches every call site. Do NOT replace this with a scanner ignore — these are remotely triggerable DoS vectors in an internet-facing service.
